article.title: An article in Simplified DocBook
article.para: This article is DocBook XML: the editor loads it, and saves it as it is. Each part of it is an element of the editor, with its DocBook name.

section.title: Elements, all the way down
section.para: A section holds its title, its paragraphs, its lists and its sections. An emphasis is an element too, in a line of text.

listitem.para: Put the cursor here: the breadcrumbs show the path of the DocBook elements.
Right-click an element for its menu, or press Alt+Enter to insert an element where the cursor is.

section.title: Code, quotes and links
section.programlisting: const article = editor.getData(); // The article, as DocBook XML.

blockquote.para: Press Source to see the XML, and to edit it.

section.para: A link keeps its address: DocBook. Click it to see its attributes.
